title: Sigurnost, privatnost i etika
Security, privacy and ethics
summary: GDPR, podaci klijenata, NDA, autorska prava, označavanje i EU AI Act.
GDPR, client data, NDAs, copyright, labelling and the EU AI Act.

q: Smiješ li zalijepiti ime i email klijenta u javni chatbot?
May you paste a client's name and email into a public chatbot?
options: Ne bez pravne osnove i odobrenog alata. Anonimiziraj.
Not without a legal basis and an approved tool. Anonymize.
explain: Osobni podaci traže pravnu osnovu i zaštitu.
Personal data needs a legal basis and protection.

q: Anonimizacija prije prompta smanjuje rizik.
Anonymizing before the prompt reduces risk.
explain: Zamijeni imena oznakama, izbaci kontakte.
Replace names with labels, drop contacts.

q: GDPR je Opća uredba o zaštiti ___.
GDPR is the General Regulation on the protection of ___.
explain: Uredba EU-a koja štiti osobne podatke.
An EU regulation protecting personal data.

q: Spojite podatak s postupkom.
Match the data with the handling.
explain: Klasificiraj podatke prije svakog unosa.
Classify data before every input.

q: Složite siguran tijek s podacima.
Order a safe data workflow.
explain: Zapis upotrebe pomaže pri reviziji.
A usage log helps audits.

q: Što je sigurnije?
Which is safer?
a: I paste the whole CRM export.
b: Zamijenim imena oznakama (Kupac A) i izbacim kontakte.
I replace names with labels (Customer A) and drop contacts.
explain: Daj modelu samo ono što mu treba.
Give the model only what it needs.

q: Koja institucija u Hrvatskoj nadzire zaštitu osobnih podataka?
Which institution in Croatia supervises personal data protection?
explain: AZOP je nacionalno nadzorno tijelo.
AZOP is the national supervisory authority.

q: NDA može zabraniti dijeljenje materijala s alatima trećih strana.
An NDA can forbid sharing material with third-party tools.
explain: Provjeri ugovor prije nego išta zalijepiš.
Check the contract before pasting anything.

q: Tko ima autorska prava na AI sadržaj?
Who holds copyright in AI content?
options: Ovisi o državi i ljudskom doprinosu. Provjeri pravila i dodaj bitan ljudski rad.
It depends on the country and human contribution. Check rules and add real human work.
explain: Pravo se još razvija, pa budi oprezan.
The law is still evolving, so be careful.

q: EU AI Act uvodi obveze transparentnosti, npr. označavanje deepfakea.
The EU AI Act introduces transparency duties, e.g. labelling deepfakes.
explain: Detalje i rokove provjeri u službenom tekstu.
Check details and deadlines in the official text.

q: Kad bi publika mogla biti zavedena, AI sadržaj treba ___.
When the audience could be misled, AI content should be ___.
explain: Označavanje gradi povjerenje.
Labelling builds trust.

q: Spojite situaciju s praksom.
Match the situation with the practice.
pairs: A realistic AI photo of a person
explain: Etika je dio kvalitete posla.
Ethics is part of the quality of the work.

q: Smije li AI oponašati glas stvarne osobe u oglasu?
May AI imitate a real person's voice in an ad?
explain: Glas i lik su osobni podatak i pravo osobe.
Voice and likeness are personal data and a person's right.

q: Lažne AI recenzije su dopuštene ako su pozitivne.
Fake AI reviews are fine if they are positive.
explain: Lažne recenzije su obmana potrošača.
Fake reviews deceive consumers.

q: Složite etičku provjeru prije objave.
Order the ethical check before publishing.
explain: Pet pitanja, dvije minute, manje problema.
Five questions, two minutes, fewer problems.

q: Što je ispravnije?
Which is more appropriate?
a: Generiram lice „zadovoljne kupkinje” i predstavljam je kao stvarnu.
I generate the face of a “happy customer” and present her as real.
b: Koristim označenu ilustraciju ili stvarne fotografije uz privolu.
I use a labelled illustration or real photos with consent.
explain: Ne predstavljaj izmišljeno kao stvarno.
Don't present the invented as real.

title: MCP konektori
MCP connectors
summary: Model Context Protocol: što je, kako radi, kako ga povezati i osigurati.
Model Context Protocol: what it is, how it works, how to connect and secure it.

title: Što je MCP i zašto postoji
What MCP is and why it exists

q: Što je MCP?
What is MCP?
options: Otvoreni standard za povezivanje AI aplikacija s alatima i podacima
An open standard for connecting AI applications to tools and data
explain: MCP je kratica za Model Context Protocol.
MCP stands for Model Context Protocol.

q: MCP se često opisuje kao „USB-C za AI”: jedan standardni priključak za mnogo alata.
MCP is often described as “USB-C for AI”: one standard connector for many tools.
explain: Isti protokol umjesto zasebne integracije za svaki par.
One protocol instead of a separate integration for every pair.

q: MCP znači Model ___ Protocol.
MCP stands for Model ___ Protocol.
explain: Cilj je dati modelu pravi kontekst: alate i podatke.
The goal is to give the model the right context: tools and data.

q: Koji problem MCP rješava?
What problem does MCP solve?
options: Svaka aplikacija nije više trebala vlastitu integraciju za svaki alat
Each app no longer needs its own integration for every tool
explain: Umjesto N×M integracija, imaš N+M.
Instead of N×M integrations you have N+M.

q: Spojite ulogu s opisom.
Match the role with the description.
pairs: AI aplikacija koju koristiš (npr. asistent ili IDE)
The AI app you use (e.g. assistant or IDE)
Dio hosta koji priča MCP s jednim serverom
The host part that speaks MCP to one server
Program koji izlaže alate i podatke
A program that exposes tools and data
An action the model can call
explain: Host sadrži klijente, svaki klijent jedan server.
A host contains clients, each client one server.

q: MCP server mora biti napisan u jednom određenom jeziku.
An MCP server must be written in one specific language.
explain: Postoje SDK-ovi za više jezika, npr. TypeScript i Python.
SDKs exist for many languages, e.g. TypeScript and Python.

q: Složite jedan poziv alata.
Order a single tool call.
steps: The host decides to use a tool
explain: Model sam bira alat prema opisu.
The model picks the tool from its description.

q: Tko podržava MCP?
Who supports MCP?
options: Više velikih proizvođača i mnogo alata, a lista raste
Several major vendors and many tools, and the list keeps growing
explain: Standard je prvi predstavio Anthropic 2024., a prihvatili su ga i drugi. Provjeri popis za svoj alat.
Anthropic introduced the standard in 2024 and others adopted it. Check the list for your tool.

q: Spojite MCP element s opisom.
Match the MCP element with its description.
pairs: How it connects: stdio or HTTP
explain: Tri „primitiva” poslužitelja plus način prijenosa.
Three server “primitives” plus the transport.

q: Server se pokreće kao lokalni proces na tvom računalu. Koji transport?
The server runs as a local process on your computer. Which transport?
explain: stdio je jednostavan za lokalne alate.
stdio is simple for local tools.

q: Server radi na internetu. Što se obično koristi?
The server runs on the internet. What is typically used?
options: HTTP (Streamable HTTP) uz autentikaciju, npr. OAuth
HTTP (Streamable HTTP) with authentication, e.g. OAuth
explain: Udaljeni serveri trebaju prijavu i dozvole.
Remote servers need login and permissions.

q: MCP poruke temelje se na JSON-RPC 2.0.
MCP messages are based on JSON-RPC 2.0.
explain: Standardni format zahtjeva i odgovora.
A standard request-and-response format.

q: Model bira alat prema njegovom ___ pa mora biti jasan.
The model picks a tool by its ___ so it must be clear.
explain: Dobar opis je pola dobrog alata.
A good description is half of a good tool.

q: Koji opis alata je bolji?
Which tool description is better?
b: „Kreira događaj u Google kalendaru. Ulaz: naslov, početak, kraj (ISO 8601). Ne šalje pozivnice.”
“Creates an event in Google Calendar. Input: title, start, end (ISO 8601). Doesn't send invitations.”
explain: Opis kaže što, s kojim ulazom i koje su granice.
A description states what, with which input and the limits.

q: Složite životni ciklus alata.
Order the tool lifecycle.
explain: Klijent najprije pita server što zna.
The client first asks the server what it can do.

q: Resursi i alati su isto: oboje izvršavaju radnje.
Resources and tools are the same: both perform actions.
explain: Resursi se čitaju, alati izvršavaju radnje.
Resources are read, tools perform actions.

title: Konektori u praksi: ChatGPT, Claude, Grok i drugi
Connectors in practice: ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and others

q: Gdje se obično dodaje MCP konektor?
Where is an MCP connector usually added?
options: U postavkama aplikacije (konektori) ili u konfiguracijskoj datoteci
In the app's settings (connectors) or in a config file
explain: Točan put se razlikuje po aplikaciji. Slijedi njezinu dokumentaciju.
The exact path differs per app. Follow its documentation.

q: Spojite konektor s primjerom upotrebe.
Match the connector with a use case.
pairs: Summarize a channel, send a draft
explain: Konektor daje AI-ju pristup tvojim stvarnim podacima.
A connector gives the AI access to your real data.

q: Dostupnost konektora i vlastitih MCP servera ovisi o aplikaciji i planu pa provjeri aktualnu dokumentaciju.
Availability of connectors and custom MCP servers depends on the app and plan, so check current documentation.
explain: Ove mogućnosti brzo se mijenjaju.
These capabilities change quickly.

q: Što napraviti prije povezivanja konektora na radni račun?
What should you do before connecting a connector to a work account?
options: Pročitaj koja dopuštenja traži i pitaj IT ako treba
Read which permissions it asks for and ask IT if needed
explain: Dopuštenja su stvarni pristup tvojim podacima.
Permissions are real access to your data.

q: Povezivanje udaljenog konektora obično traži prijavu i ___ pristupa.
Connecting a remote connector usually asks for sign-in and ___ of access.
explain: Pročitaj što odobravaš.
Read what you're approving.

q: Složite siguran početak s konektorom.
Order a safe start with a connector.
steps: Connect an account with minimal rights
explain: Počni s čitanjem, pisanje dodaj kasnije.
Start with reading, add writing later.

q: Koja je praksa bolja?
Which practice is better?
a: Povezujem konektor na glavni račun s punim pravima.
I connect a connector to the main account with full rights.
b: Koristim zaseban račun s ograničenim pravima.
I use a separate account with limited rights.
explain: Manje pristupa znači manji rizik.
Less access means less risk.

q: Svaki konektor je siguran jer ga je netko objavio.
Every connector is safe because someone published it.
explain: Objava nije jamstvo sigurnosti.
Publication is no guarantee of safety.

q: Što je prompt injection preko alata?
What is prompt injection through tools?
options: Napadač sakrije upute u dokument ili stranicu koje model pročita i slijedi
An attacker hides instructions in a document or page that the model reads and follows
explain: Sadržaj koji alat vrati nije pouzdan izvor uputa.
Content a tool returns is not a trusted source of instructions.

q: Tekst koji alat vrati može sadržavati zlonamjerne upute.
Text a tool returns can contain malicious instructions.
explain: Zato radnje s posljedicama traže ljudsko odobrenje.
That's why consequential actions need human approval.

q: Načelo najmanjih ___ znači da daješ samo nužna dopuštenja.
The principle of least ___ means giving only the necessary permissions.
explain: Svaka dodatna ovlast je dodatni rizik.
Every extra permission is extra risk.

q: Spojite rizik s obranom.
Match the risk with the defence.
pairs: Ne slijedi upute iz podataka, traži potvrdu radnji
Don't follow instructions from data, confirm actions
Ključevi u upravljanju tajnama, ne u promptu
Keys in a secret manager, not in the prompt
explain: Svaki rizik ima poznatu obranu.
Every risk has a known defence.

q: Server za „pretvaranje teksta u velika slova” traži pristup cijelom disku. Što radiš?
A “convert text to uppercase” server asks for access to the whole disk. What do you do?
options: Odbijem ili ograničim. To je crvena zastavica
Refuse or restrict. It's a red flag
explain: Zatraženo mora odgovarati svrsi.
What's requested must fit the purpose.

q: Složite uključivanje novog servera.
Order enabling a new server.
explain: Povjerenje se gradi postupno.
Trust is built gradually.

q: Automatsko odobravanje svih poziva alata uvijek je sigurno.
Auto-approving every tool call is always safe.
explain: Odobravaj ručno sve što piše, šalje ili briše.
Approve manually anything that writes, sends or deletes.

q: Koji tijek je sigurniji za slanje emaila klijentima?
Which flow is safer for emailing clients?
a: The agent sends on its own.
b: Agent priprema nacrt, čovjek odobri slanje.
The agent drafts, a human approves sending.
explain: Čovjek u petlji kod nepovratnih radnji.
A human in the loop for irreversible actions.

title: Claude Code
Claude Code
summary: Agentski alat za kodiranje i automatizaciju: CLAUDE.md, plan mode, MCP, hooks i subagenti.
An agentic coding and automation tool: CLAUDE.md, plan mode, MCP, hooks and subagents.

q: Što je Claude Code?
What is Claude Code?
options: Agentski alat koji radi u terminalu ili IDE-u i čita, uređuje i pokreće kôd u tvom projektu
An agentic tool that works in the terminal or IDE and reads, edits and runs code in your project
Just a chatbot with no file access
explain: Za razliku od običnog chata, može izvoditi radnje u projektu uz tvoje odobrenje.
Unlike a plain chat it can act in your project with your approval.

q: Spojite naredbu sa svrhom.
Match the command with its purpose.
pairs: Starts a session in the current folder
Summarizes the chat and frees context
explain: Ove četiri naredbe koristiš stalno.
You'll use these four constantly.

q: Claude Code predlaže izmjene datoteka koje potvrđuješ prije primjene.
Claude Code proposes file changes that you confirm before they're applied.
explain: Prema zadanim postavkama pita za odobrenje.
By default it asks for approval.

q: Sesiju započinješ upisivanjem ___ u mapi projekta.
You start a session by typing ___ in the project folder.
explain: Prvo se pozicioniraj u mapu projekta.
First change into the project folder.

q: Čemu Claude Code služi marketingašu koji ne programira?
What is Claude Code useful for to a marketer who doesn't code?
options: Skripte za obradu CSV-a, izvještaji, izrada stranica, uređivanje mnogo datoteka odjednom
Scripts to process CSVs, reports, building pages, editing many files at once
explain: Opišeš cilj običnim jezikom, a on napiše i pokrene skriptu.
You describe the goal in plain language and it writes and runs the script.

q: Složite prvu sesiju.
Order a first session.
explain: Uvijek pregledaj prije odobravanja.
Always review before approving.

q: Prije odobravanja treba pročitati predložene izmjene i naredbe.
You should read proposed changes and commands before approving.
explain: Ti si odgovoran za ono što se pokrene.
You're responsible for what runs.

q: Koji zadatak je bolji?
Which request is better?
b: „U reports/ je CSV s kampanjama. Napiši skriptu koja izračuna CPA po kanalu i spremi report.md. Prvo mi pokaži plan.”
“reports/ has a campaigns CSV. Write a script that computes CPA per channel and saves report.md. Show me the plan first.”
explain: Cilj, lokacija, izlaz i plan.
Goal, location, output and a plan.

q: Što je CLAUDE.md?
What is CLAUDE.md?
options: Datoteka s uputama o projektu koju Claude Code učitava na početku sesije
A file of project instructions that Claude Code loads at the start of a session
explain: Konvencije, naredbe i pravila na jednom mjestu.
Conventions, commands and rules in one place.

q: CLAUDE.md treba biti kratak i konkretan, dugi nejasni zapisi troše kontekst.
CLAUDE.md should be short and concrete; long vague notes waste context.
explain: Piši ono što model ne može sam zaključiti.
Write what the model can't infer itself.

q: U ___ načinu (plan mode) Claude istražuje i predlaže plan bez mijenjanja datoteka.
In ___ mode Claude researches and proposes a plan without changing files.
explain: Plan mode je siguran početak za veće zadatke.
Plan mode is a safe start for larger tasks.

q: Spojite način rada s ponašanjem.
Match the mode with its behaviour.
pairs: Only reads and proposes a plan
explain: Biraj najstroži način koji ti radi posao.
Pick the strictest mode that gets the job done.

q: Kontekst je pun i Claude gubi nit. Što radiš?
The context is full and Claude loses the thread. What do you do?
explain: Svjež kontekst je često najbolji lijek.
A fresh context is often the best cure.

q: Složite dobar zahtjev.
Order a good request.
explain: Plan prije izmjena štedi popravke.
A plan before edits saves fixes.

q: Koji unos u CLAUDE.md je bolji?
Which CLAUDE.md entry is better?
b: „Jezik: HR. Testovi: npm test. Ne diraj /content bez validacije.”
“Language: HR. Tests: npm test. Don't touch /content without validation.”
explain: Konkretna pravila se mogu provjeriti.
Concrete rules can be checked.

q: Bypass dozvola koristi se samo u izoliranom, sigurnom okruženju.
Bypassing permissions should be used only in an isolated, safe environment.
explain: Bez odobrenja nitko ne zaustavlja pogrešku.
Without approvals nothing stops a mistake.

q: Spojite značajku sa svrhom.
Match the feature with its purpose.
pairs: Naredba koja se automatski pokreće na događaj
A command that runs automatically on an event
Paket uputa i skripti za ponovljiv zadatak
A bundle of instructions and scripts for a repeatable task
A specialized helper with its own context
explain: Sve četiri proširuju što Claude Code zna i smije.
All four extend what Claude Code knows and may do.

q: Koja naredba dodaje MCP server u Claude Code?
Which command adds an MCP server to Claude Code?
explain: Za udaljeni server dodaješ i vrstu transporta i URL.
For a remote server you add the transport type and URL.

q: Projektne MCP postavke mogu se dijeliti s timom kroz datoteku .mcp.json u projektu.
Project MCP settings can be shared with the team through a .mcp.json file in the project.
explain: Tako cijeli tim ima iste alate.
That way the whole team has the same tools.

q: Hook je shell naredba koja se automatski pokreće na određeni ___.
A hook is a shell command that runs automatically on a certain ___.
explain: Npr. nakon svake izmjene pokreni formatiranje.
E.g. run formatting after every edit.

q: Želiš automatsko formatiranje nakon svake izmjene datoteke. Što koristiš?
You want automatic formatting after every file edit. What do you use?
explain: Hook je pouzdan jer ne ovisi o tome hoće li model zapamtiti.
A hook is reliable because it doesn't depend on the model remembering.

q: Kada delegirati zadatak subagentu?
When should you delegate a task to a subagent?
options: Kad bi pretraživanje velikog koda zatrpalo glavni kontekst
When searching a large codebase would clutter the main context
explain: Subagent vrati samo sažetak.
A subagent returns only a summary.

q: Složite automatizaciju tjednog izvještaja.
Order automating a weekly report.
explain: Prvo ručno, tek onda automatski.
Manual first, automatic after.

q: claude -p „upit” pokreće Claude Code bez interaktivnog sučelja, pogodno za skripte.
claude -p “prompt” runs Claude Code non-interactively, suited to scripts.
explain: Takav headless način ide u rasporede i CI.
That headless mode fits schedules and CI.

title: Codex i radni tokovi agenata
Codex and agent workflows
summary: OpenAI Codex, AGENTS.md, sandbox, odobrenja i usporedba alata.
OpenAI Codex, AGENTS.md, sandboxing, approvals and tool comparison.

q: Što je Codex?
What is Codex?
options: OpenAI-jev agent za programiranje, dostupan u terminalu, IDE-u i oblaku
OpenAI's coding agent, available in the terminal, IDE and cloud
explain: Piše, pokreće i testira kôd na tvoj zahtjev.
It writes, runs and tests code on request.

q: AGENTS.md je datoteka s uputama o projektu za agenta, slična CLAUDE.md-u.
AGENTS.md is a file of project instructions for an agent, similar to CLAUDE.md.
explain: Isti princip: trajne upute o projektu.
Same principle: standing project instructions.

q: Spojite pojam s opisom.
Match the term with its description.
pairs: Zadaci u izoliranom okruženju koji vraćaju izmjene na pregled
Tasks in an isolated environment that return changes for review
explain: Provjeri aktualne mogućnosti u službenoj dokumentaciji.
Check current features in the official docs.

q: Izvršavanje u ograničenom, izoliranom okruženju zove se ___.
Running in a restricted, isolated environment is called a ___.
explain: Ograničava štetu ako nešto pođe po zlu.
It limits damage if something goes wrong.

q: Što znači stroži način odobravanja?
What does a stricter approval mode mean?
options: Agent traži potvrdu prije izmjena i naredbi
The agent asks for confirmation before edits and commands
explain: Strože je sporije, ali sigurnije.
Stricter is slower but safer.

q: Složite delegiranje zadatka Codexu.
Order delegating a task to Codex.
explain: Pregled diffa je obavezan.
Reviewing the diff is mandatory.

q: Koji zadatak je bolji?
Which task is better?
b: „U /site dodaj stranicu /cijene s tablicom iz pricing.csv. Ne mijenjaj navigaciju. Pokreni testove.”
“In /site add a /pricing page with a table from pricing.csv. Don't change navigation. Run the tests.”
explain: Opseg i granice smanjuju iznenađenja.
Scope and limits reduce surprises.

q: Konfiguracija agenta i MCP serveri postavljaju se u njegovoj konfiguracijskoj datoteci.
Agent settings and MCP servers are set in its configuration file.
explain: Točan format i putanju provjeri u dokumentaciji.
Check the exact format and path in the docs.

q: Koja je najvažnija navika s agentima za kôd?
What is the most important habit with coding agents?
options: Review the diff and run tests
explain: Agent može pogriješiti uvjerljivo.
An agent can be wrong convincingly.

q: Spojite alat s tipičnom snagom.
Match the tool with a typical strength.
explain: Mogućnosti se preklapaju i brzo mijenjaju.
Capabilities overlap and change fast.

q: Isti zadatak vrijedi isprobati u dva alata prije standardizacije.
It's worth trying the same task in two tools before standardizing.
explain: Tako vidiš razliku u kvaliteti i trošku.
You see the difference in quality and cost.

q: Prije spajanja izmjena pročitaj ___ (razlike u kodu).
Before merging changes, read the ___ (code differences).
explain: Diff pokazuje što se točno promijenilo.
A diff shows exactly what changed.

q: Složite siguran tijek s agentom.
Order a safe agent flow.
explain: Grana omogućuje jednostavan povratak.
A branch makes rollback easy.

q: Čemu agent ne smije imati pristup?
What must an agent not have access to?
explain: Daj mu testno okruženje.
Give it a test environment.

q: Što je sigurnije?
Which is safer?
a: The agent directly on the production database.
b: Agent na kopiji ili testnom okruženju.
The agent on a copy or test environment.
explain: Pogreške na kopiji ne koštaju ništa.
Mistakes on a copy cost nothing.

q: Agent koji kodira ne treba testove jer piše ispravan kôd.
A coding agent doesn't need tests because it writes correct code.
explain: Testovi su tvoja zaštita.
Tests are your safeguard.
